aeg-backbone.name: N-(2-Aminoethyl)glycine (Aeg Backbone)
aeg-backbone.role: Achiral, uncharged pseudopeptide backbone replacing the sugar-phosphodiester scaffold of natural nucleic acids.
aeg-backbone.catalogue_group: 1. Standard Achiral PNA Monomers & Structural Backbone

T.name: Fmoc-PNA-T-OH (Thymine PNA Monomer)
T.role: Standard Fmoc-protected thymine monomer for automated SPPS on Intavis MultiPep RSi synthesizer.
T.catalogue_group: 1. Standard Achiral PNA Monomers & Structural Backbone

A.name: Fmoc-PNA-A(Bhoc)-OH (Adenine PNA Monomer)
A.role: Standard Fmoc-protected adenine monomer bearing exocyclic N6-Bhoc acid-labile protection.
A.catalogue_group: 1. Standard Achiral PNA Monomers & Structural Backbone

C.name: Fmoc-PNA-C(Bhoc)-OH (Cytosine PNA Monomer)
C.role: Standard Fmoc-protected cytosine monomer with exocyclic N4-Bhoc protecting group.
C.catalogue_group: 1. Standard Achiral PNA Monomers & Structural Backbone

G.name: Fmoc-PNA-G(Bhoc)-OH (Guanine PNA Monomer)
G.role: Standard Fmoc-protected guanine monomer featuring N2-Bhoc protection for clean SPPS elongation.
G.catalogue_group: 1. Standard Achiral PNA Monomers & Structural Backbone

Aglu.name: Fmoc-A(Bhoc)-γ-Glu-OH (Chiral γ-L-Glutamyl PNA Adenine)
Aglu.role: Chiral (S)-γ-modified PNA adenine building block derived from L-glutamic acid. Key component validated in batch DGL-260520-001 (DGL 299-3p_6.0). Induces a stable right-handed duplex conformation with elevated target affinity and improved water solubility.

Cglu.name: Fmoc-Cglu(Bhoc)-OH (Chiral γ-L-Glutamyl PNA Cytosine)
Cglu.role: Chiral (S)-γ-L-glutamyl cytosine PNA monomer with OtBu ester and Bhoc protection. Pre-organizes PNA into a right-handed helix and eliminates sequence-dependent aggregation.

Gglu.name: Fmoc-Gglu(Bhoc)-OH (Chiral γ-L-Glutamyl PNA Guanine)
Gglu.role: Chiral (S)-γ-L-glutamyl guanine PNA monomer. Completes the chiral γ-Glu PNA quartet, preventing G-quadruplex formation while increasing RNA binding affinity.

Tglu.name: Fmoc-T-γ-Glu-OH (Chiral γ-L-Glutamyl PNA Thymine)
Tglu.role: Chiral (S)-γ-L-glutamyl thymine monomer validated in batch DGL-260520-001. Provides steric pre-organization, ΔTm enhancement, and negative carboxylate charge post-deprotection.

*L-Ser*.name: Fmoc-*L-Ser*-OH (Chiral Abasic DGL PNA Monomer)
*L-Ser*.role: Chiral L-serine-derived abasic building block validated in batch DGL-260520-001. Features a protected (S)-CH2OtBu γ-sidechain and central Boc-protected secondary amine, creating the defined pocket for Dynamic Chemical Labeling (DCL).
*L-Ser*.descriptor_note: Catalogue iupac/role text gives (S); CIP computed from the catalogue SMILES is (R). The SMILES is correct - the text carries the L-serine starting material's descriptor without recomputing after the COOH->CH2-N priority swap. Spatial configuration is unambiguous and unchanged; only the label differs.

*aeg*.name: Fmoc-Aeg-OH (Achiral Abasic DGL Monomer)
*aeg*.role: Achiral abasic monomer generating an unhindered secondary amine pocket within the PNA duplex for Watson-Crick guided dynamic base incorporation (Patent WO2018011320).

*GL*.name: Blank Monomer - *GL* (Boc-γ-L-Glu-PNA-COOH)
*GL*.role: Chiral abasic PNA monomer with glutamic acid sidechain (ee = 100%, Tr = 14.929 min on Cellulose-1, RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.504 min) (Step 6).
*GL*.catalogue_group: 7. γ-Chiral Glutamic PNA Platform (PS_Gamma Glu & SOP_EE)

*D-Ser*.name: Blank Monomer - *D-Ser* (Compound 6b / Boc-γ-D-Ser(tBu)-PNA-COOH)
*D-Ser*.role: Chiral (R)-D-serine abasic blank monomer (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.459 min) (Step 5).
*D-Ser*.descriptor_note: Catalogue iupac/role text gives (R); CIP computed from the catalogue SMILES is (S). The SMILES is correct - the text carries the L-serine starting material's descriptor without recomputing after the COOH->CH2-N priority swap. Spatial configuration is unambiguous and unchanged; only the label differs.

*L-DAPA*.name: Blank Monomer - *L-DAPA* (Fmoc-γ-L-DAPA(Boc)-Blank-PNA-COOH)
*L-DAPA*.role: Chiral (S)-L-diaminopropionic acid abasic monomer for amine functionalization (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.232 min).
*L-DAPA*.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

*D-DAPA*.name: Blank Monomer - *D-DAPA* (Fmoc-γ-D-DAPA(Boc)-Blank-PNA-COOH)
*D-DAPA*.role: Chiral (R)-D-diaminopropionic acid abasic monomer (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.232 min).
*D-DAPA*.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

Cpeg.name: Cpeg (Fmoc-γ-(mini-PEG)-C(Bhoc)-PNA-OH)
Cpeg.role: Solubilizing PEGylated cytosine PNA monomer preventing probe aggregation (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.073 min).
Cpeg.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

Tpeg.name: Tpeg (Fmoc-γ-(mini-PEG)-T-PNA-OH)
Tpeg.role: Solubilizing PEGylated thymine PNA monomer (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 5.223 min).
Tpeg.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

Clys.name: Clys (Fmoc-γ-L-Lys(Boc)-C(Bhoc)-PNA-OH)
Clys.role: Cationic lysine-modified cytosine PNA monomer conferring positive charge post-cleavage (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 6.389 min).
Clys.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

Tlys.name: Tlys (Fmoc-γ-L-Lys(Boc)-T-PNA-OH)
Tlys.role: Cationic lysine-modified thymine PNA monomer conferring positive charge (RP-HPLC CBU-2 Tr = 5.627 min).
Tlys.catalogue_group: 9. PEGylated, Cationic & Modified PNA Monomers (Analytical Table 2)

SMART-C-REX-PEG12-biotin.name: SMART C REX PEG12-Biotin (Aldehyde Cytosine Probe)
SMART-C-REX-PEG12-biotin.role: Flagship SMART base reagent for Dynamic Chemical Labeling (DCL). Features an N1-formylmethyl reactive aldehyde head for reversible imine condensation and reductive amination within the abasic DGL pocket, coupled via a monodisperse PEG12 spacer to D-biotin for magnetic bead capture.

X.name: Fmoc-AEEA-OH (Fmoc-EAAE-OH / Mini-PEG-2 Spacer)
X.role: 8-amino-3,6-dioxaoctanoic acid (mini-PEG-2) spacer validated in batch DGL-260520-001 (Monomer Code: X). Separates recognition sequences from solid surfaces, fluorophores, or affinity tags.

RAM.name: Fmoc-Rink Amide Linker (RAM Linker)
RAM.role: Acid-labile anchor on TentaGel S RAM and TentaGel XV resins (0.23 mmol/g loading), releasing C-terminal primary carboxamides (-CONH2) upon TFA cleavage.

NaBH3CN.name: Sodium Cyanoborohydride (NaBH3CN)
NaBH3CN.role: Chemoselective reducing agent for reductive amination of α-amino aldehydes with glycine methyl ester.
